items.title: External API calls need timeout retry and idempotency policy
items.statement: External API integrations should define timeout, retry, idempotency, authentication, rate-limit, partial-failure, and reconciliation behavior.
items.revalidation_trigger: Provider API version, SLA, or retry semantics change.

items.title: External API test pattern
items.statement: Test external API integrations with success, authentication failure, timeout, retry, duplicate request, rate-limit, and reconciliation cases.
items.revalidation_trigger: Integration contract or failure semantics change.

items.title: External API clients may need circuit breaker behavior
items.statement: High-volume or high-impact external API clients should consider circuit breaker behavior to avoid cascading failures.
items.revalidation_trigger: Traffic volume, provider SLA, or resiliency requirements change.
